scope: Rapid implementation-focused review of Cell Painting compound-held-out morphology retrieval, experimental confounding, and public numeric-profile feasibility. This is not a systematic review.
inclusion_criteria: Primary peer-reviewed work directly informing the selected Cell Painting data, interpretation of morphological profiles, or technical variation.
Official source documentation with explicit provenance, numeric-profile availability, metadata and reuse terms.
Evidence usable to motivate a limited within-panel benchmark without claiming direct target identification.
exclusion_criteria: No use of uninspected candidate records as support for scientific claims.
No assertion of complete abstract or full-text assessment for records outside the three retained papers.
No raw-image processing or prospective wet-lab implementation in this project.
Datasets without a sufficiently clear license, tractable numeric profiles or required compound/experimental metadata were not selected.

official_sources_inspected.purpose: Dataset provenance, license, profile levels, metadata, source object paths and upstream processing workflow.
official_sources_inspected.decision: Selected as the numeric-profile source. Upstream raw annotated well medians were used instead of globally spherized or feature-selected profiles.
official_sources_inspected.limits: Targeted repository and source-object inspection, not a complete code audit or reproduction of the upstream image-analysis pipeline.

implementation_implications: Use an explicitly licensed, pinned source and preserve raw-profile and metadata hashes.
Separate repeated wells from independent related-compound groups.
Declare annotation, dose, replicate and class-support exclusions before scoring.
Fit predictive transformations on training compound profiles; use same-plate DMSO controls for the declared normalization procedure.
Expose technical-effect diagnostics and remove shared plate-map references in the primary retrieval task.
Report ineligible queries, small denominators, simple baselines and restricted within-panel interpretation.
Do not claim that literature validates the fixed thresholds or that a same-annotation match proves target engagement.
review_limits: Single-pass rapid review, not registered or systematic; no duplicate screening or formal risk-of-bias assessment.
Three retained primary papers were inspected only in partial full-text excerpts; full articles and supplements were not covered.
Supplementary web result counts and per-record exclusion reasons were not preserved.
No exhaustive forward/backward citation search, comparison of all datasets, or independent biological validation.
The selected small fixed panel does not establish generalization to unseen cell types, doses, laboratories or molecular mechanisms.
